grid.title: 1 — Electricity grid
grid.description: Prefer ONE method: separate import/export sensors, or a genuine signed grid sensor. Use instantaneous power in W or kW. With separate import/export, signed power can be left empty. A sensor that stays at zero during export does not describe both directions. Selected readings are not added together.

data_description.grid_power: Optional. Must change sign between import and export. This beta preserves the source convention; do not choose an energy counter in kWh.
data_description.grid_import: Power purchased from the grid, normally positive or zero. This is not total home consumption.
data_description.grid_export: Power sent to the grid. Negative source values are accepted and displayed as a positive magnitude.

solar.title: 2 — Solar production
solar.description: Choose total solar production power in W or kW. An existing calculated sum of inverter outputs is suitable. Do not choose daily energy in kWh or exported surplus. Leave empty if you have no solar installation.

home.title: 3 — Home consumption
home.description:
Home consumption is instantaneous power used by all loads: lighting, appliances, heating, water heating, EV… regardless of electricity source. Battery charging is accounted for separately. It is expressed in W/kW, not kWh.

Choose an existing sensor (measured or already calculated), or let eHome EMS calculate the balance. A meter or CTs covering all loads, or a consistent sum, can provide this measurement. A grid-exchange meter often measures only import/export; with solar and storage, it is not total home load power by itself.

Initial automatic calculation requires consistent AC measurements: separate grid import/export, AC solar production and AC charge/discharge for every active battery. Confirm the equipment and boundary below, then configure batteries in the next step.

data.home_power: Existing home sensor (measured or already calculated)
data.home_boundary_confirmed: I confirm the same AC boundary for all balance readings

data_description.home_power: Existing sensor mode: select your total reading; an existing calculated template is suitable. It must not depend on the EMS home sensor. This field is ignored in automatic calculation mode.
data_description.home_power_mode: Existing sensor: value is used without a new balance. EMS calculation: home = PV + import + discharge − export − charge. Switching modes preserves the EMS sensor unique ID.
data_description.home_has_solar: Only for EMS calculation. When checked, solar power must be mapped. Do not uncheck to bypass missing readings on an actual solar installation.
data_description.home_has_storage: Only for EMS calculation. In the next step, declare every battery participating in daily exchanges as active, with BOTH charge and discharge. Backup means outside this daily balance. Active DC storage blocks the simple AC calculation.
data_description.home_boundary_confirmed: Check meter placement, double counting and AC-side battery power. Internal pack/DC power is not interchangeable with AC power. EMS calculation cannot be enabled without confirmation.
data_description.home_max_age_seconds: Default 300 s. If a required source is missing, unavailable, invalid or older than this limit, the result remains unavailable. No missing data is replaced by zero. Age is checked every 30 s.

review.title: 6 — Review measurements

confirm.title: Save in observation mode
confirm.description:
{summary}

Confirming saves observation mappings. The eHome EMS view is added automatically to the sidebar once the integration loads and follows its settings. An administrator can create an independent editable copy from that view without YAML. Existing copies are never overwritten. No equipment is commanded. Animated flows and EMS daily balances remain to be developed. Settings reload without a full HA restart.

batteries.title: 4 — Storage
batteries.description:
Add your batteries, or continue without storage. Each battery has separate readings. Backup is the default role.

{summary}

add_battery.title: Add a battery
add_battery.description: Map at least one reading and give the battery a clear name. Missing readings can be left empty. Charge and discharge are distinct positive instantaneous powers. SOC is a percentage; remaining energy is the current stock, not a lifetime input counter.

data_description.name: Display name, for example Main battery or Backup battery.
data_description.role: Active: participates in daily exchanges. Backup: separate monitoring, outside the future active balance. Neither role sends commands.
data_description.coupling: AC: storage connected on the AC side. DC: monitoring is available, but the simple AC balance needs a topology adapter.
data_description.capacity_kwh: Declared usable capacity in kWh for the monitored system. This is neither power in W nor remaining energy. Example: 8.2 kWh.
data_description.charge_power: Power currently entering the battery. Do not select a cumulative charged-energy counter.
data_description.discharge_power: Power currently leaving the battery for loads. Discharge is not automatically solar-origin energy.
data_description.soc: Current state of charge between 0 and 100%, not an energy reading in kWh.
data_description.remaining_energy: Optional: currently available stored energy in Wh/kWh. Do not select Total Grid Energy, daily energy, or lifetime charge/discharge counters. Leave empty without a suitable source. Declared cumulative counters are rejected; above capacity × 1.10, the association is flagged inconsistent.

battery_details.description: Map at least one reading and give the battery a clear name. Missing readings can be left empty. Charge and discharge are distinct positive instantaneous powers. SOC is a percentage; remaining energy is the current stock, not a lifetime input counter.

Leave empty without a suitable source. Declared cumulative counters are rejected; above capacity × 1.10, the association is flagged inconsistent.

remove_battery.title: Remove battery from monitoring
remove_battery.description: Removal is applied at final confirmation. It does not command the device or remove its original integration.

usages.title: 5 — Loads: solar router, EV and other appliances
usages.description:
Add loads to show separately, or continue without any. Their consumption is already included in total home demand; it will not be added again. This monitoring sends no commands to F1ATB, the charger or other equipment.

{summary}

add_usage.title: Add load
add_usage.description: Map at least one existing reading or status. Monitoring stays read-only and preserves router and charger automations.

data.name: Load name
data.included_in_home: I confirm this load belongs to the home consumption boundary

data_description.name: For example Water heater via F1ATB or EV charging.
data_description.kind: The type organizes the display; it does not create a direct router or vehicle connection.
data_description.power: Choose measured load power, not an SSR percentage or setpoint. A water-heater meter can suit F1ATB; for an EV, use charger consumption, not whole-home power.
data_description.energy: Mirrors an existing counter without integrating power or inventing missing energy. Leave empty without a suitable source.
data_description.energy_period: Choose the source's actual period: today, session or cumulative total. A cumulative counter is not automatically converted into today's energy.
data_description.status: Read-only status: routing, charging or plugged state, depending on the selected source. Even switch entities are only read; no commands are offered.
data_description.included_in_home: These loads are breakdowns of the home total. They are not added or subtracted again in the Home calculation.

usage_details.description: Map at least one existing reading or status. Monitoring stays read-only and preserves router and charger automations.

data.included_in_home: I confirm this load belongs to the home consumption boundary

data_description.kind: The type organizes the display; it does not create a direct router or vehicle connection.
data_description.power: Choose measured load power, not an SSR percentage or setpoint. A water-heater meter can suit F1ATB; for an EV, use charger consumption, not whole-home power.
data_description.energy: Mirrors an existing counter without integrating power or inventing missing energy. Leave empty without a suitable source.

data_description.included_in_home: These loads are breakdowns of the home total. They are not added or subtracted again in the Home calculation.

remove_usage.description: Removal is applied at final confirmation. It does not remove equipment or its integration, and sends no commands.

error.select_source: Select at least one sensor before saving.
error.duplicate_source: The same sensor is mapped to multiple balance readings.
error.recursive_source: Select an original source, not an eHome EMS sensor.
error.missing_source: A required reading is missing. EMS calculation needs import/export and all present equipment power channels.
error.unsupported_unit: Invalid unit: W/kW for power, % for SOC, Wh/kWh for remaining energy.
error.sources_changed: A mapping is inconsistent: missing source, duplicate, wrong unit, cumulative counter or stock above capacity. Return to review.
error.invalid_battery: Check name, role, coupling and capacity (a finite positive number).
error.cumulative_energy: This sensor is declared as a cumulative energy counter. Choose current remaining stock, or leave this field empty.
error.exceeds_capacity: This energy is more than 10% above declared capacity. Check sensor, unit and capacity, or leave the field empty.
error.boundary_unconfirmed: First confirm that balance readings share the same AC boundary.
error.solar_configuration: Check declared solar presence and the mapping in the Solar step.
error.storage_configuration: Check declared storage presence and active batteries in the Storage step.
error.unsupported_topology: An active battery is declared DC. The simple AC balance is not suitable; use an existing home sensor.
error.invalid_usage: Check name, type and energy period.
error.outside_home: This screen details loads already included in the home. Confirm this boundary before adding the load.
